scenario.title: Unreachable Goal and Recovery
scenario.description: A single open gap connects two warehouse areas. Closing it isolates the open goal; reopening it restores access. The robot does not move while the goal is unreachable.

scenario.title: Widespread Map Changes
scenario.description: This medium synthetic map keeps its entire boundary open while scattered interior cells are blocked and restored in batches. It illustrates broad map edits and makes no claim that incremental planning is faster.
